verdict.rationale: The GPU's ROCm software stack has its own documentation for libraries such as hipBLAS, hipRAND and rocSOLVER, and the AI Developer Hub offers runnable Jupyter Notebook tutorials for training, fine-tuning and inference. That gives some runnable examples, but nothing shows an interactive API reference, and the OpenAPI probe found no API spec. missing for 10: an interactive API explorer or playground, runnable examples embedded in the API reference itself, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the interactive experience.
